subject.title: [Security] Path traversal validation bypass in secret-file.ts with relative path injections

question: Does the ACP token/password-file surface promise sandbox-root-relative paths, or does it accept operator-selected host paths whose contract is limited to safe file opening and permission checks?
rationale: The exploit claim and proposed fix depend on a root-bounded relative-path contract that the issue does not establish, while current documentation points to shared secret-file primitives.

options.title: Run private boundary audit
options.body: Validate the exact current-main and v2026.7.1 input contract privately with focused traversal cases before deciding whether code must change.

options.body: Ask the reporter for an exact command or request, version, platform, configured root, and harmless proof file without publishing sensitive host data.
